issues.extracted: charges for services/fees / other charges for services
issues.issue: From the governmental statement (p6), this group is roughly Expense reimbursements 444,820.85 + Meters/planting 216,743.57 + Chemigation permits 77,880 + Rental 39,245.28 + Misc 46,269.95 + Insurance proceeds 3,606.81. Reimbursements are more than half of it, and the extractor recorded the same 444,820.85 as reimbursements/refunds in receipts, so the dominant-category rule points to reimbursements/refunds. The Statement of Activities (p3) treats it as charges for services, so this is a judgment call; it already carries review.
Notes say 'listed by object' but the lines don't carry the review flag the rules call for.
